# Reading a pattern: whether it is one, and within the limits every implementation holds to.
#
# pattern ; outcome ; why ; from ; construct
#

# refusal and for BEYOND the limit it is past, from is where in the pattern, in scalar values, the
# construct that decided it begins, and construct is that construct as written.
